defect: After the owner closes, a fill of several extents whose placement was promised before the close still places extents and is granted its shard hold; its receive is then refused `Closed`, so the grant only takes capacity.

property.text: Close refuses new receives, reservations and publications.

evidence.steps: No fault. Over a storage with a sequence arena, a fill of a two-extent object promises its placement with no extent placed (FillAttempt::promise_storage), the owner closes (Owner::close), and the kept placement then places both extents (PlacingFill::place) and takes its shard hold (PlacingFill::reserve_storage), which grants the fill. Owner::close closes the volume's readiness and leaves the storage's cutoff open, and the hold's revalidation reads only the cutoff. The history k9-placement-across-close (net/world_tests/histories/keyops.rs) runs these steps over Geometry::Sequenced.
evidence.sweep: One sweep of cluster-swarm, cluster-pressure and upload on the unfixed build: root bsw-ct1-2101-probe-cluster-424e30371 under the campaign root, archive of head 424e30371 (build a22460533b6e3c6ed9968422d2fd549011e75c64e8393cc0301ac16c368bd18b, dirty false), campaign bsw-ct1-2101-probe-cluster-424e30371, 28 workers for 60 s; runs 0..6192 of cluster-swarm, 0..14407 of cluster-pressure and 0..158022 of upload, each run at its own root; suspects 0, new_suspects 0, replays 27, 1700 control runs caught and none missed, no alarm. cluster-swarm and cluster-pressure build their storage with storage_shaped_as over the fixture geometry (net/world_tests/cluster.rs), and upload runs UPLOAD_PLAN, which keeps QUIET's Geometry::Fixture, through Geometry::storage (net/world_tests.rs); the fixture geometry's storage has no sequence arena, so no fill of the three named profiles promises a placement of several extents: promise_storage refuses MultipleExtents without one.
